title: 04. OOP: Instance Methods, Class Methods & Static Methods
summary: A class can have 3 types of methods. Think of them as 3 types of employees in a company:
objectives: Instance Methods, Class Methods & Static Methods

sections.title: EXPLANATION (Junior Developer Level)
sections.body:
A class can have **3 types of methods**. Think of them as 3 types of employees in a company:

```
🔵 Instance Method  = A regular employee who works on their OWN tasks
                      → has access to self (the individual employee's data)

🟡 Class Method     = An HR Manager who works on COMPANY-WIDE policies
                      → has access to cls (the whole company/class)
                      → decorated with @classmethod

🔴 Static Method    = A consultant who does a general task
                      → doesn't need company data OR employee data
                      → decorated with @staticmethod
```

### Syntax at a Glance:
```python
class MyClass:
    class_var = 10

    def instance_method(self):        # 🔵 has self → can access instance & class
        return self.class_var

    @classmethod
    def class_method(cls):            # 🟡 has cls → can access class, NOT instance
        return cls.class_var

    @staticmethod
    def static_method():              # 🔴 no self, no cls → pure utility function
        return "I'm independent!"
```
